name: NWA US Championship
epitaph: Recalled only because a rival federation's own preview commentary happened to list it among Nic Nyce's credentials on his way to an SJPW main event -- the NWA itself left no title match, card or roster of its own for this belt.
notes: No document from the NWA's own record names this title directly; it is recovered entirely from a third federation's commentary.

name: NWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The belt a community reminiscence remembers only as "the belt" still held by initials-only "BT" the day the promotion folded -- the last trace of a federation nobody thought to write down while it still existed.
notes: Named as "World" only by inference from the promotion's own registry caption; the held record's closure post calls it just "the belt." No title match, card or roster of the NWA's own survives for this title.
